build: Open the account planner on a grower’s own farm and restore the same account backup from a file picker or a dropped file.

changes.did: Grower account backups can be downloaded and reopened from the planner, including saved photos and sowing records.
steps: In the grower beta, save the first field to see its beds on Map, or sign in again to reopen the farm.
Use Backup to download the plan. Open the file or drop it into the grower planner to restore it after confirmation.
